packageRules.description: The action runs on node24 (action.yaml), so keep Node and its types on that major
ncc (the dist bundler) does not support TypeScript 7 (native compiler) yet: stay below 7 until it does
Group all GitHub Actions bumps into one PR
Auto-merge non-major updates once required CI checks pass: Renovate merges them itself, after rebasing and retesting, with its bypass of the review required by the PR ruleset
